                                dV4[j, k, r] += 2 * diff * U4[i, j, r] * W4[k, i, r]
                                dW4[k, i, r] += 2 * diff * U4[i, j, r] * V4[j, k, r]
                
                U4 -= lr * dU4
                V4 -= lr * dV4

            best_solution = (best_U, best_V, best_W)
